proposals.before: In the third year, sent his heir apparent Jun with Ke leading cavalry seventeen thousand east to raid Puyu, took it, captured their king and division host over fifty thousand mouths and returned.
proposals.after: In the third year, he sent his heir apparent Jun and Ke to lead seventeen thousand cavalry eastward in a raid on Puyu. They took it, captured its king and more than fifty thousand of its people, and returned.
proposals.sourceReason: 世子俊與恪率騎 identifies Jun and Ke in the expedition’s leadership; the current fragment Jun with Ke leading leaves the coordination unnecessarily unclear. 部眾五萬餘口 denotes the people captured with their king, counted as persons, not a distinct division host or necessarily fifty thousand soldiers. The complete Tongjian account likewise distinguishes Jun’s direction and Ke’s military responsibility and records 部落五萬餘口. Preserve the literal third year without selecting an era or silently adding 十. The en field already uses and Ke and a population rendering, so it needs no parallel replacement.
proposals.sourceChinese: 三年，遣其世子俊與恪率騎萬七千東襲夫餘，克之，虜其王及部眾五萬餘口以還。
proposals.reason: 世子俊與恪率騎 identifies Jun and Ke in the expedition’s leadership; the current fragment Jun with Ke leading leaves the coordination unnecessarily unclear. 部眾五萬餘口 denotes the people captured with their king, counted as persons, not a distinct division host or necessarily fifty thousand soldiers. The complete Tongjian account likewise distinguishes Jun’s direction and Ke’s military responsibility and records 部落五萬餘口. Preserve the literal third year without selecting an era or silently adding 十. The en field already uses and Ke and a population rendering, so it needs no parallel replacement.

sourceUnits.zh: 尋而宇文乞得龜為其別部逸豆歸所逐，奔死於外，皝率騎討之，逸豆歸懼而請和，遂築榆陰、安晉二城而還。
sourceUnits.en: Soon afterward Yuwen Qidegui was driven out by Yidougui of his separate division and died in exile; Huang led cavalry against Yidougui, who took fright and sued for peace; Huang then built the two cities of Yuyin and Anjin and withdrew.
sourceUnits.literal: Soon Yuwen Qidegui was by his separate division Yidougui expelled, fled and died outside; Huang led cavalry to campaign against him; Yidougui feared and requested peace; thereupon built the two cities of Yuyin and Anjin and returned.

sourceUnits.zh: 涉奕于率騎追戰于渾水，又敗之。
sourceUnits.en: Sheyiyu counterattacked at the Hun River and was beaten again.
sourceUnits.literal: Sheyiyu led cavalry to pursue battle at the Hun River and was again defeated.

sourceUnits.zh: 遣封弈率騎潛于馬兒山諸道。
sourceUnits.en: Feng Yi hid cavalry along the Ma’er Mountain tracks.
sourceUnits.literal: Sent Feng Yi leading cavalry to lurk on the roads of Ma’er Mountain.

sourceUnits.zh: 使其世子俊伐段遼諸城，封弈攻宇文別部，皆大捷而歸。
sourceUnits.en: He had his heir apparent Jun campaign against Duan Liao’s cities, and Feng Yi attack a separate Yuwen division; both returned in great victory.
sourceUnits.literal: Made his heir apparent Jun campaign against Duan Liao’s cities; Feng Yi attacked Yuwen’s separate division; both great victory and return.

sourceUnits.zh: 以其妻段氏為王后，世子俊為太子，皆如魏武、晉文輔政故事。
sourceUnits.en: He made his wife Lady Duan queen and the heir apparent Jun crown prince, all following the Wei Wu and Jin Wen precedents of assisting in government.
sourceUnits.literal: Made his wife Lady Duan queen, heir apparent Jun crown prince, all like Wei Wu and Jin Wen’s precedent of assisting government.

sourceUnits.zh: 遣子恪等率騎二千，晨出擊之。
sourceUnits.en: He sent his son Ke and others with two thousand horse in a dawn sally.
sourceUnits.literal: Sent his son Ke and others leading two thousand cavalry; at dawn they sortied and struck them.

sourceUnits.zh: 季龍遣其將麻秋率眾迎遼，恪伏精騎七千於密雲山，大敗之，獲其司馬陽裕、將軍鮮于亮，擁段遼及其部眾以歸。
sourceUnits.en: Shi Hu sent his general Ma Qiu with troops to meet Duan Liao. Murong Ke stationed seven thousand elite cavalry in ambush at Miyun Mountain and routed them, captured marshal Yang Yu and general Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao and his followers back.
sourceUnits.literal: Jilong sent his general Ma Qiu leading a host to meet Liao; Ke stationed seven thousand picked cavalry in ambush at Miyun Mountain and greatly defeated them, captured their marshal Yang Yu and general Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao and his followers back.

sourceUnits.zh: 於是率騎二萬出蠮螉塞，長驅至於薊城，進渡武遂津，入于高陽，所過焚燒積聚，掠徙幽、冀三萬餘戶。
sourceUnits.en: He then led twenty thousand cavalry out through Yeweng Pass, drove straight to Ji city, advanced across Wusui Ford into Gaoyang, burning the stores wherever he passed, and carried off more than thirty thousand households from You and Ji.
sourceUnits.literal: Thereupon he led twenty thousand cavalry out through Yeweng Pass, drove straight to Ji city, advanced across Wusui Ford, and entered Gaoyang; wherever he passed he burned the stores, and he plundered and relocated more than thirty thousand households from You and Ji.

sourceUnits.zh: 遣翰率騎擊之，渾大敗，僅以身免，盡俘其眾。
sourceUnits.en: He sent Murong Han with cavalry to strike them; Moqian Hun was badly defeated and escaped alone, while his entire host was taken captive.
sourceUnits.literal: Sent Han leading cavalry to strike them; Hun was greatly defeated, barely himself escaped, wholly captured their host.

sourceUnits.zh: 尋又率騎二萬親伐宇文歸，以翰及垂為前鋒。
sourceUnits.en: He soon took twenty thousand horse against Yuwen Gui, with Murong Han and Murong Chui as van.
sourceUnits.literal: Soon again led cavalry twenty thousand personally to campaign against Yuwen Gui, with Han and Chui as vanguard.

sourceUnits.zh: 親造《太上章》以代《急就》，又著《典誡》十五篇，以教胄子。
sourceUnits.en: He personally composed the Taishang Chapter to replace the Jijiu, and also wrote fifteen chapters of Canonical Admonitions to teach the sons of the nobility.
sourceUnits.literal: He personally composed the Taishang Chapter to replace the Jijiu, and also wrote fifteen chapters of Canonical Admonitions, to teach the sons of the nobility.

sourceUnits.zh: 慕容恪攻高句麗南蘇，克之，置戍而還。
sourceUnits.en: Murong Ke attacked Goguryeo’s Nansu, took it, posted a garrison, and returned.
sourceUnits.literal: Murong Ke attacked Goguryeo’s Nansu, took it, set garrison and returned.

sourceUnits.zh: 三年，遣其世子俊與恪率騎萬七千東襲夫餘，克之，虜其王及部眾五萬餘口以還。
sourceUnits.en: In the third year he sent his heir Jun and Ke with seventeen thousand cavalry to raid Puyu eastward; they took it, captured its king and more than fifty thousand of the tribe, and returned.
sourceUnits.literal: In the third year, sent his heir apparent Jun with Ke leading cavalry seventeen thousand east to raid Puyu, took it, captured their king and division host over fifty thousand mouths and returned.

sourceUnits.zh: 皝親臨東庠考試學生，其經通秀異者，擢充近侍。
sourceUnits.en: Huang personally went to the eastern school to examine students; those whose command of the classics was thorough and outstanding were promoted to fill posts as close attendants.
sourceUnits.literal: Huang personally arrived at the eastern school to examine students; those whose classics were thorough and outstanding, promoted to fill close attendance.

sourceUnits.en: Because of the prolonged drought, he remitted the common people's field rent.
sourceUnits.literal: Because of the prolonged drought, he remitted the common people’s field tax.

references.quote: 三年上脫年號, 按之當爲永和也. 則此「三年」當是「十三年」, 脫「十」字.
references.support: The official historical-source database reproduces two critical interpretations: Zhou’s missing Yonghe era gives347; the subsequent editorial note treats 十 as lost and reads Huang’s year13, corroborated by Tongjian’s Yonghe2/346. Neither interpretation licenses literal336activity. The Chinese source remains 三年; no textual emendation is applied.

references.quote: 燕王皝以為古者諸侯即位，各稱元年，於是始不用晉年號，自稱十二年。初，夫餘居於鹿山，為百濟所侵，部落衰散，西徙近燕，而不設備。燕王皝遣世子俊帥慕容軍、慕容恪、慕輿根三將軍、萬七千騎襲夫餘。
references.support: The first sentence is in Yonghe1/345; the Fuyu raid is separately in Yonghe2/346. This supports the critical edition’s year13calculation while preserving Zhou’s competing347interpretation.
